question: On a substrate engineered for asymmetric (amortized/cached) discovery with budget-stable, credential-free execution characteristics, can we construct or identify a task bank/endpoint configuration that produces genuine behavioral variance (COLD success_rate meaningfully below the 1.0 ceiling) such that a four-arm comparison (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, with parameterized mechanism carrier bound to git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) has non-degenerate dynamic range under counter-only metrics, without rerunning the mandatory-discovery symmetric REST certificate?
hypothesis: The three consecutive ceiling failures on the mandatory-discovery symmetric deterministic REST substrate class (mandatory, symmetric discovery for every arm) are substrate-induced, not general. A credential-free substrate permitting asymmetric discovery (one-time session/resource/schema discovery amortized or cached across tasks within a session/family) will produce COLD success_rate < T_ceiling (with T_ceiling = 0.95, discriminating margin) while preserving measurement validity and deterministic counters, enabling a discriminating test of the parameterized inheritance mechanism under counter-only economics (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts).
falsifier: No credential-free substrate/configuration meeting the asymmetric-discovery requirements produces COLD success_rate < 0.95 under the frozen task-family constraints and counter-only measurement validity; or the resulting configuration cannot satisfy the certificate shape (design-time dynamic-range certificate cannot be made true) while meeting budget stability and credential-free constraints; or treatment liveness/comparator distinction cannot be achieved without reintroducing the symmetric mandatory-discovery certificate that failed three times.

baselines.name: Cold start with asymmetric discovery allowed (amortized/cached across tasks)
baselines.description: Re-derivation baseline where discovery cost is incurred at most once per session/family as permitted by the substrate (contrast to symmetric per-task mandatory discovery).

baselines.name: Retrieval-shaped comparator under asymmetric discovery
baselines.description: Retrieval-shaped control under the same asymmetric discovery regime to provide a strong comparator.

baselines.name: Literal kernel baseline
baselines.description: Literal path control to confirm treatment liveness distinct from literal kernel behavior.

baselines.name: Registry emptied
baselines.description: Registry emptied control to confirm registry is the carrier (matches cold behavior under the same regime).

positive_control.name: Exact replay positive control
positive_control.description: Exact replay expected to achieve success under valid substrate; confirms substrate correctness independent of treatment.

null_control.name: Known negatives null control
null_control.description: Known-invalid goals refuse with bound_action=null and correct reason categorization.
null_control.expected: refusals == total_known_negatives, all with bound_action == null and reason in allowed set

measurement_validity: credential-free execution (no model calls, no browser automation, no external network services beyond local loopback if used; any loopback strictly local deterministic stub)
deterministic counters only for economics: http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts (explicitly excludes latency_ms/1000 as discriminating instrument)
model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 for all arms under this readiness design
success criteria reproducible and audit-recomputable from raw accounting
no outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN phase (only satisfiability probes allowed)
separates RAW EVIDENCE / OBSERVATION / DERIVED MEASUREMENT / INTERPRETATION per packet contract

decision_rule.description: Readiness gate: accept design as satisfying blocker-removal criteria if (1) design-time dynamic range certificate is computable and true under asymmetric-discovery substrate for B-COLD-ASYM and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED-ASYM (success_rate_cold_asym < 0.95 at novelty levels requiring work compression), (2) treatment liveness demonstrated structurally (T vs B-LITERAL-KERNEL distinction exists), (3) positive/null controls satisfiable, (4) counter-only economics identifiable, (5) provisioning path is explicit (credential-free, budget-stable), and (6) design explicitly excludes rerunning the mandatory-discovery symmetric REST certificate. FAIL if any of these is unsatisfiable. EXECUTE of full 4-arm benchmark is deferred until endpoint provisioning readiness is established per mandate; this experiment is a DESIGN+readiness validation (pre-freeze satisfiability) not a re-execution of the failed certificate.
accept_if_all: dynamic_range_cert.design_certified == true and dynamic_range_cert.observed_certified == true (design-time certificate under asymmetric-discovery regime)
success_rate(B-COLD-ASYM, novelty >= n0) < 0.95 for at least one discriminating novelty level (or margin >= delta)
reject_if_any: dynamic range cannot be achieved without reintroducing symmetric mandatory discovery
provisioning requires external credentials or unbounded budget
treatment structurally incapable of becoming EXECUTABLE under asymmetric regime

product_consequence_positive: Establishes discriminating substrate for C-LLM-INHERIT economics (removes blocker B2). Enables valid test of parameterized inheritance under counter-only metrics without re-running the failed certificate class; prevents wasting cycles on non-discriminating tests.
product_consequence_negative: If asymmetric-discovery substrate cannot produce discriminating dynamic range while remaining credential-free and budget-stable, explicitly document provisioning receipt and do not proceed to full benchmark; park the thread rather than rerun the mandatory-discovery symmetric REST certificate. This prevents further non-discriminating executions.
estimated_cost: low (design-time satisfiability probes only; no outcome-bearing measurements, no model inference)
expected_information_gain: high (resolves critical measurement-readiness blocker; prevents repeated non-discriminating experiments)
